title: Google I/O 2011: Chrome Dev Tools Reloaded
summary: Paul Irish and Pavel Feldman present the newest Chrome Dev Tools features at Google I/O 2011, including live CSS editing, saving changes, breakpoints and network analysis. It also covers remote debugging.
why: In 2011 HN people cited it as a convincing introduction that won them over to Chrome's developer tools.

quote.text: I am Sold. I am switching to WebDev tools.
